text:
I fixed finding 20261127-134134-P5-1. I haven't run the SEQ-002 test itself, and I didn't run `start_app` since only a class file changed. Typecheck and drift are both clean.

In `BookingService.create`, the rule check (`bookingRuleChecker.check`) now runs first. After it, `roomRepository.findById` loads the room, and then the inactive-room rejection and `saveIfFree` follow. That matches the SEQ-002 call order the test asserts. The change is confined to `src/domain-services/BookingService.ts`.

An unknown room id now reaches the room lookup only after the rule check passes. A booking that fails the time rules is therefore rejected on those rules, even if the room doesn't exist.
